# iCreatives

> > A creative staffing and recruiting agency specializing in UI/UX designers, marketing talent, and AR/VR gaming professionals across multiple US locations.

iCreatives is a full-service creative staffing agency founded by Ray Brown and Steven Cohen, connecting companies with specialized design, UX, and marketing professionals. The agency offers talent placement, contract staffing, and franchise opportunities across creative disciplines including digital design, motion graphics, and emerging technologies.
